scripts.build: node -e "const AdmZip = require('adm-zip'); new AdmZip('AHK APP WORLD.zip').extractAllTo('.', true); const fs = require('fs'); const path = require('path'); const dir = './AHK APP WORLD'; if (fs.existsSync(dir)) { fs.readdirSync(dir).forEach(file => { fs.renameSync(path.join(dir, file), path.join('.', file)); }); fs.rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true }); }"
